basis: Independent prospective review of design and accession names only.
additional_descriptive_ridges: Task/timing/completed-utterance word count/confidence only, and those features plus lexical identities without motion; same training rows, loss, weights and regularization as all ridges. Include both in all-model group results.
duplicates: Within a recording sort by end, then start and event ID. Retain first complete event per cutoff grid row; after past eligibility is established retain first event per last observed native wrist tick. This avoids counting a repeatedly reused sensor sample as another independent forecast. Report exclusions before consulting target.
donors: The two token bags must differ after projection to the final training vocabulary. Use distinct training R group with same task. Compare all controls including the primary and physical benchmarks on an identical donor-matched population; also show all-scorable MAE.
